task.description: Implement Letflow.Obs.Logger (:logger_formatter behaviour), Letflow.Obs namespace module, config/config.exs logger wiring, and config/runtime.exs LOG_LEVEL validation per design lib/letflow/design/req193-structured-logging.md.

result.summary: Implemented Letflow.Obs.Logger (lib/letflow/obs/logger.ex) with: format/2 and check_config/1 callbacks for the :logger_formatter OTP behaviour; ISO 8601 UTC microsecond timestamp formatting; level_to_string (:warning -> "warn"); trace_id from Logger.metadata; component from :mfa first element via inspect/1 with Elixir. prefix strip; message formatting for {:string, iodata}, charlist-format, and inspect fallback; reserved-field enforcement with :logger.warning re-entry guard; redact_sensitive/1 covering exact key list (atoms + strings) and suffix-based wildcard (_token, _secret, _password, _credential); with_trace/1 using try/after and Logger.reset_metadata for prior-trace-id restore. Letflow.Obs namespace module (lib/letflow/obs.ex) added. config/config.exs: added 'config :logger, backends: []' and ':default_handler, formatter: {Letflow.Obs.Logger, []}'. config/runtime.exs: added LOG_LEVEL case with raise on unrecognised value, feeding 'config :logger, level: log_level_atom'. Compile output: 'Compiling 26 files (.ex)\nGenerated letflow app' (first run); 'Compiling 2 files (.ex)' after format auto-fix. Both mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted exit 0 with no output.
issues: Logger.delete_metadata/1 does not exist in Elixir 1.18 — used Logger.reset_metadata/1 with Keyword.delete/2 instead (design spec said 'or equivalent').
check_config/1 behaviour callback was required by :logger_formatter but not mentioned in task spec — added trivially returning :ok.
